i.norm: Tests for {@link Tag} covering case-insensitive tag lookup and the semantic flags exposed for the {@code <div>} element.

Tag names are matched case-insensitively when resolved through the default HTML parse settings, so "script" and "SCRIPT" must produce equal tags. When resolved from the same {@link TagSet}, the lookups even return the very same cached instance.
{@code <div>} is a well-known block-level element, so it reports as a block tag, not an inline tag, and is recognised as a known tag.
